verdict.rationale: Jira's feature pages say users can create custom automations with Rovo AI, from reminders to 'rules that move work forward', and can connect tools like Slack and Bitbucket to any Jira workflow with automation. That implies a non-coding path to building rules. However, the evidence is only high-level marketing copy. Nothing explicitly documents a no-code rule builder or multi-step chains of triggers, conditions and actions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a no-code visual rule builder, evidence of multi-step rule composition, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a product manager can build such automations unaided.
